This will be an A to B run, with the circle at C and the party at D. Kick-off is at Muttenz Bahnhof - note that this is quite a way from the tram line, so even if you're coming from Basel it's still best to take the train. A bag wagon will be provided.
The circle will be at the down-down park in Basel (better known as the Schutzenmattpark), with showers and changing etc. available at Mad Max's place. Later troughing and partying will be at the Zic Zac.

Start of the run is at the end of the No. 2 tram route in Binningen, about 10 minutes ride from Basel SBB. This is an A to B run hared by Dancing John and Mealticket. A bag car will be provided.
The On-Inn is at Dancing John and Pork Future's place, at Gellertstrasse E 26670 N), where we're all invited to a Holiday Party. RSVP to .

From Basel SBB: it's about half an hour's walk, or: take Tram 1, direction Voltaplatz/Messeplatz (northwestwards), 4 stops, to Brausebad. Change to Tram 6, direction Allschwil Dorf (westwards). Stops are Allschwilerplatz, Morgartenring, then, passing the Zic-Zac Rock Garden pub/restaurant, in Baselland, LINDENPLATZ.
From the rear of the tram, walk between the Italian restaurant and the kiosk, towards the PTT (there is a small park on your left). Continue towards the CO-OP, passing some hideous garden sculptures on your right. Turn right into Lindenstrasse. Pass 2 small older houses (numbers 17 & 19!) on your left, then turn left up a small path, leading to a newish block of flats, nos 21 & 23. There is a visitors' carpark on the right of this path. We intend to hold the circle on the balcony of Mealticket's flat, and continue at the Zic-Zac at about 18:30.

The first Basel run of the new century is an A to B run starting at the SBB treffpunkt. B will be at Logic's house, Baselmattweg 143 in Allschwil. The On-Inn is at the Zic Zac (no surprises there), and a bag car will be provided.

This run will be hared by Andy Manning and "Dancing" John Patient. It's an A to B run (bag car provided) where B is Chez Andy and Steph Manning: 5 rue du Stade, Leymen, France, . For the hard of thinking: bring your passport!

This is probably an A to B run, a bag car will be provided. Bring passports and french francs.
The Mulhouse train leaves the french side of Basel SBB at 13:30, arriving at 13:52. You're advised to get a through ticket, as the SBB counters at Basel are unreliable. Apparently.

After months of intense debilitation, the BSH3 Mismanagement has dessicated that the May hare will be Mad Max, and the run will take place in Schwörstadt.
Some of you may already be trying to formulate questions along the lines of 'huh???', so...
Where is it?
Schwörstadt is in Germany, about 7 km east of D-Rheinfelden. This may not in itself be particularly interesting, but it means:
BRING YOUR PASSPORTS!
The run
The run will be A to A, starting and finishing at Schwörstadt Canoe Club. No idea about the trail, but that merely continues a fine tradition with the BSH3.
The venue
The SCC is a great venue if the weather is warm, which I'm sure it will be, as we have nutscrews with the RA's name on them. The clubhouse has german beer, a riverside garden, great scenery, seats, tables and er... more german beer. There will be (quite decent) food, delivered by an Italian takeaway place.
Your mismanagement committee has provided all this a mere 100m stagger from Schwörstadt station - you can see the SCC club house as you get off the train.
Too good to be true
It sure is - the last train back from Schwörstadt is at 21:24. As we're starting earlier, some may argue that this may well be long enough. For those who disagree, I'm sure the usual suspects will be available to get completely Yeltsined in Basel.
How to get there
The only reasonable connection is from the Basel Badischer Bahnhof at 12:57 - there will be a haphazard assembly in the entrance hall of the Bad. Bhf. from about 12:30.
Your best connections are:
From Departing Arriving (at Basel SBB) Bern 10:49 11:56 Zuerich 11:00 12:08 Geneva 08:47 11:38
Take note
The Basel Badischer Bahnhof is on the other side of the city from the Basel SBB! Some trains continue to the Bad. Bhf (it's worth asking the conductor), but usually you'll have to take a number 2 tram from outside the SBB. The above connections allow time for this.
Latecomer cockup procedure
If you miss the 12:57 from the Bad. Bhf, you have a problem! The only viable option is to take a train from Basel SBB to CH-Rheinfelden, then get a taxi across the border to D-Schwörstadt. This will cost at least SFr. 30!
If all else fails
The hare's mobile no: .

This is an A to B run, with a bag car provided. The location of B will be divulged to hashers arriving by car, who may wish to park there, whence they can take a direct tram to the SBB. The On-Inn will be at a nearby restaurant.

This will be an A to A run, with an On-Inn BBQ at the hare's house. Grillables are provided, and there's also crash space available for those who want to stay over (bring a sleeping bag). RSVP to the hare.
Coming by train, take the 12:04 from Zuerich, or the 12:03 from Bern, arriving in Basel at about 13:15. Walk left out of the station, keeping on the left (and ignoring the first traffic-light controlled junction) until you come to a crossroads with the UBS Training Centre (a large red-brick building) facing you.
Keep going past the UBS Training Centre (a wall of water shows the way, then a "Magic" bank cash machine), and you will see the signpost to the new Flamingosteg bridge, direction Zoo. At the bottom of the bridge is the tramstop. A 2-zone ticket will take you as far as Leyman. You need to take the 13:30 tram; the next one that goes as far as Leyman leaves at 14:00.
From the Leymen tramstop, walk in the direction of the tram that you just got off and follow the flour!
For car drivers, the hare has issued the following blah:
Our house is facing the football ground in Leymen. Coming from Basel: Pass the Swiss-French Zoll then pass the French Zoll, come to a T-junction, turn right, cross the little bridge, pass the dirt-layby, turn right down the road in front of the purple set of apartments. Turn left into the drive after the set of purple apartments.
Coming From France (Hagental-le-Bas direction): Come down the winding road, as you enter Leymen (i.e pass the sign) slow down, take the second left after the Leymen Sign, pass the purple set of flats, then turn left up the drive.
For the hard of thinking, this run is in France. Don't forget your passports!

Basel SBB (French Platform) to Bartenheim - 13.10, Arrival 13.25
A to B run, where B is Chez Flying Bottom and Wheelchair. A bag car will be available. After the run, food will be arranged at B. Further details can be obtained from Flying Bottom or or mobile. Crash space and tent space are available.

For the hard of thinking, this run is in France. Don't forget your passports!

This run will probably involve public transport so make sure that you have money, half price cards etc on your person.
For the latecomers, down-downs will be held at the Schuetzenmatt Park (61011E 26686N), and the On-Inn will be at the ZicZac, who are coincidentally having a "5 Joor ZicZac" party.

Get a 1-zone ticket (1.40CHF with Halbtax) from Basel SBB and hop on a number 2 tram to get to the Eglisee tramstop. As is usual on BSH3 runs, the DDs will be held in the usual place in the Schuetzenmattpark (61011E 26686N). The On-Inn will be at a nearby restaurant.

An exotic trail with hares John "George Mooney" Hyland and John "Dancing Doghouse" (ex Dancing John, Shirley Knott etc), Patient.

From there, it's a B to C run, for the circle. Then C to D for the On-Inn, D being the hare's (DD's) hutch, for cold beer and chilli.

Basel SBB train station car park, on Gueterstrasse. Walk through the "Unterfuehrung" (pedestrian tunnel), following signs for Tram 16. A bag car will be provided. Circle, beer, and food, at the hare's abode - see above.

A bag car will be provided, and for the benefit of late-comers the circle will be held in the usual place (Schuetzenmattpark).

From Basel SBB, take a tram number 2 to its Eglisee terminus. Change to a number 6, to its terminus at Riehen Grenze (the German border at Loerrach). You'll need a 1-zone ticket for the journey.
Type: A to B. A bag car will be provided.

Roll up, roll up; this is Dancing Doghouse's "Goodbye Basel" hash. Come and marvel at the how the trail can be cocked up in a new and imaginative manner!

When you get off the tram, follow Marsstrasse for about 200m until you reach a T-junction. Turn left and after about 10m you'll see some curved yellow and grey buildings on your right. Look for number 143; the name on the bellpush is "Larussa/Goepel".
Kick-off from Gelterkinden railway station. A bag car will be available. Bring money for a restaurant.

Shared taxis back to Basel Airport (20 minutes) and bus to SBB from there.

Start: Weilstrasse tram stop (on number 6 route - 2 stops before Riehen Grenze) at 2pm. Finish: Our new flat - Untere Rebgasse 10, 4058 Basel. Getting to the start; take a number 11 tram from the Basel SBB direct to St. Johanns Tor. A 1-zone ticket is required, and the journey takes 11 minutes. Trams run every 8 minutes during the middle of the day.

Meet at Zürich Brunau for an A to B run 14:00 on Saturday March 15th. On in will be somewhere in Adliswil so it's probably best to buy a return ticket to Adliswil.

The hare would appreciate RSVPs asap ) so the manager will remain convinced of our arrival.

If you decide to go straight to the run start at the Zoo, we do not guarantee that there will be a bag car.

There will be an A to B run (bag car available) starting from Baden station.
The On-Inn will be at the hare's hutch. There will be a BBQ going, so bring something to grill (salads will be provided for those who don't eat meat).

Mellingerstrasse 56a Baden

C is On-On at hare's hole, where dinner will be provided...
Those coming by transport other than by train should meet at A at 13:53.

Take tram 8 to Claraplatz, leaves from Basel SBB every 8 minutes.
Meet at hare's hutch, Untere Rebgasse 10. Run will be in-town and buggy friendly. On-Inn will probably be at the Fischerstube, (RSVP so we can have numbers). Bag and shower facilities will be provided.

Stops are Allschwilerplatz, Morgartenring, then, passing the Zic-Zac Rock Garden pub/restaurant, in Baselland, Lindenplatz.

This is an A to B run, and a bag car (with cold beer) will be provided.

This will be an A to B run from Haagen railway station. Remember to bring a passport if you are travelling from Switzerland!
On-Inn: Kantine Brauhaus, Fabrikstrasse 5, Loerrach. RSVP to Heavy Breather to reserve a seat at the On-Inn.
This will be an A to B run; bag car provided. On-in at the hare's hutch. RSVP to the hare on . Mobile on the day is .

This will be an A to B run starting from Pratteln Bahnhof, with B maybe even being the same as A. In any event, a bag car will be available to transport your belongings. There will be an easter-egg hunt at the beer stop!
This will be the last Logic hash, as he's leaving town soon...

It will be an A to B run.
The plan is to cross over into France at some point during the run so ID cards or passports will be required. There is a possibility of two beer stops!

A to B run where B is Hare's Hole.
Cars left at the railway station will be collected after the run and before the down downs. Those coming by train will return to Basel by shared taxi to Basel airport (15 mins) and then bus to SBB etc.
Bag Car Provided

Take tram 11 to the Reinach Dorf tramstop (direction Aesch). Trams run every 7 or 8 minutes. Journey time 21 mins.
This will be an A to A to B run - i.e. we'll get the tram back to the Hare's Hole for On-Inn and BBQ after the run. Hares will provide grub - so RSVP would be appreciated.

Please come to Basel to celebrate the coincidence of the Bacchanalia Under The Moonshine hash (which takes place every full moon) and the special fireworks display which Basel Stadt (and other groups) lay on in honour of the birthday of the recognised founder of the Hash House Harriers, A.S. Gispert (born 31/07/1903).
The run will start and end under the Wettsteinbrucke, southern (high) end, near the premises of the Dragon Boat Club, where we will eat and drink afterwards.
